claim: 반송 기한 90일(불법 운송은 30일)을 사건 발생일 기준으로 관리한다
evidence: Checklist item. The deadlines do not run from the incident date: Art 22(2): 'within 90 days ... after the competent authority of dispatch becomes aware or has been advised by the competent authorities of destination or transit that the consented shipment ... cannot be completed as intended and has been informed of the reasons therefor'; Art 23(1): 'within 90 days ... after the date on which the person who arranges the shipment informed the competent authority of dispatch'; Art 25(5): 'within 30 days ... following the date on which the competent authority of dispatch becomes aware of, or has been advised ... of, the illegal shipment, and informed of the reasons therefor' (Art 25(8): same for the competent authority of destination). The commentary elsewhere in the same document states these start points correctly.
fix: 반송 기한 90일(불법 운송은 30일)을 발송 관할당국이 사실과 사유를 알게 되거나 통보받은 날(부속서 VII 운송은 주선한 자가 발송 관할당국에 알린 날)부터 계산해 관리한다

evidence: 44 paragraphs checked (Art 22(1)-(12), 23(1)-(7), 24(1)-(4), 25(1)-(15), 26(1)-(6)) plus responsibility/cost tables and old-law comparison (old Art 22-25 verified); law-text translation found accurate; 1 problem (checklist)
